intro: Host unforgettable gatherings with Premio. Its beautifully curved legs and solid wood design combine elegance with strength, making it the ideal centrepiece for celebrations that bring people closer​.

features.title: Strong rubberwood frame
features.text: Built with a rich mahogany finish, this piece offers enduring strength and elegance you’ll enjoy for years.

features.title: Curved legs for elegance
features.text: Function meets style. Curved legs provide stability while adding a unique, modern design element to your table.

features.title: Durable and reliable tabletop
features.text: Whether it’s breakfast or dinner, the 19 mm thick tabletop provides reliable support for all your dining needs.

features.title: Rich mahogany finish
features.text: The rich mahogany colour brings timeless charm, complementing traditional interiors beautifully.

features.title: Classic and stylish design
features.text: Stylish curved legs don’t just support—they add a stunning visual element that elevates your space.

care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
